$comment: Valenor Studio version feed, read by versionChecker.lua. Updated by Valenor Portal.

changes: Fixed the make-up and tattoo colour that could be lost or reset when a character changed clothes.
Fixed clothing tints and layered shirts, vests and coats not being reapplied correctly after changing or toggling outer clothes.
Fixed face make-up and face overlays being skipped when the head was not ready yet, and fixed morph values sometimes not being saved for twin morphs.
Fixed other players seeing a different outfit, shirt or fitted body than the owner, because worn pieces are now synced to nearby players.
Fixed the look being reapplied after a spawn, character selection or reload, so the clothing stays on.
Fixed hogtied, lassoed and dragged players being able to open the shop or clothing menu.
Improved the appearance sync to other players by only sending updates when the anchor data actually changed.
Added a Shared.Sync.Enabled option to turn off drawing face make-up, face shape and height on other players' peds.
Fixed addon emotes such as the gang signs and the pose packs not playing since 2.0.0.
(If some emotes still do not play after updating: close RedM fully and delete
